name: HealthyNotch
soft_passes: #4 16px squint: nested blue frame shrinks the heart to ~40% of canvas; individual pixels and the two-pixel sparkle smear below ~32px
#5 single light model: top-lit blue plate + heart vs bottom-glowing inner tile — two implied directions, coheres only as 'emitted screen glow'
#9 era coherence: clean Big Sur container, but baked bright top-edge specular gestures at Liquid Glass without real translucency/refraction
failures: #10 variant robustness: identity welded to the dark navy tile; magenta heart loses contrast in tinted/clear/light modes; not authored as robust Icon Composer light/dark/mono layers (era-conditional against the macOS-26 bar)

palette.background: blue base plate ramp #ACDAFF->#3B86F6 (top-lit) + inset dark navy tile ramp #010203->#153B70 (upward bloom)

light_model: Primary top-down (blue plate bright at top edge #ACDAFF, heart brightest at top, top-left sparkle); inset dark tile inverts to a bottom-up blue bloom reading as emitted screen glow. Short baked micro-highlights, no long shadows.
layer_stack: inset dark navy inner tile (~10-11px border, upward blue bloom #010203->#153B70)
pixel-art heart glyph (red->magenta->purple ramp + pink outline)
devices: 8-bit / pixel-art HP heart with the classic two-pixel specular sparkle (health + score fused for a gamified work-wellness app)
nested 'screen' tile: dark navy inner tile framed inside a bright blue squircle plate
inverted inner glow: dark-top -> lit-bottom, opposite of Big-Sur sky logic, reading as screen bloom
rhymes_hint: pixel glyph on a framed dark screen — rhymes with 8-bit/emulator game-glyph icons and dark-tile 'glowing glyph' dev/terminal icons; structurally rhymes with Alcove (same notch niche: dark recessed field + inverted glow). Palette family: cornflower-blue plate + magenta/pink glyph.
notes: 128x128 web render only (SHA-1 2f996458), not the 1024 master: hex is reliable, fine geometry is not — pixel-heart cells blur and the sparkle is at the edge of legibility. Full-bleed squircle, art inside mask. Not genuine Liquid Glass: no translucency/refraction and a baked edge specular the system would rather apply itself; classified big-sur with a deliberate 8-bit content quotation. Strong subject communication (heart = health/care) with a gamified 'balance score' twist; the app's notch name goes unillustrated (heart metaphor wins). Cover palette coheres: cornflower blue #428EFC + single magenta heart pop.
